test_case.test_name: ED-24 independent Uncore change-default, fabric and target restoration
test_case.purpose: Independently prove an approved Uncore change persists and restore the explicitly selected factory or project target without interconnect, topology, power or RAS regression.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/KVM operator and maintenance window
Backup, recipe application and KVM/physical/CMOS recovery plan
test_case.test_command: For this row only, capture baseline page and effective Uncore state; change one approved reversible control/group, save/reboot and prove retention plus all affected domains. Invoke firmware Load Defaults and record factory state. If DEFAULT_TARGET=PROJECT_RECIPE, apply the approved recipe and reboot. Compare final page, fabric/topology/power/RAS and preserved errors to the selected target.
test_case.expected_result: The change persists; all phases meet signed boot, UPI/PCIe, NUMA/memory, cache/frequency/power and RAS criteria; factory output is separate; final state exactly matches selected Factory Default or Project Recipe.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only against declared DEFAULT_TARGET with row-specific screens and signed effective-domain evidence. Factory cannot satisfy a Project Recipe case. Wrong persistence/restoration, link/topology/power/RAS anomaly or boot failure is FAIL. Missing target/oracle/recovery is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until target, matrices, value effects, limits and recovery are signed.
Never execute all/random or unqualified Uncore controls.
Back up project settings; preserve SEL/AER/EDAC/MCA/kernel counters and row-specific evidence.
Operator controls save/reboot/default/recipe/recovery; no automatic retry or CMOS clear.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, ED-11/ED-24 approval and platform identity
Declared target, factory/project matrices and reversible change rationale
Unique baseline, changed, retained, Load-Defaults, optional recipe and final screenshots
Backup/restored state, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop on link, topology, power, RAS or boot anomaly and preserve evidence. Qualified personnel restore backed-up project state through signed KVM/physical/CMOS recovery; do not reuse row 2178 evidence or blindly retry.
